lines.quote: Designed and implemented the beamforming pipeline for Tuulikallio's 64-element phased-array sonar module (2014-2016), including frequency-domain beamforming with per-element calibration correction.
Wrote the complete DSP firmware in C for Tuulikallio's first standalone acoustic-processing unit, running on a TI C6748 DSP at 300 MHz.

Built and maintain the company's production Python test and calibration framework, originally written in 2018 to replace an ad-hoc collection of MATLAB scripts. Now used across three product lines, maintained by the wider product engineering team.
That meant S-parameter measurements on a vector network analyser, antenna radiation-pattern sweeps in our small anechoic chamber, and front-end gain and noise-figure calibration.
Implemented an extended Kalman filter for real-time bearing estimation in Tuulikallio's passive sonar array product (2019-2021).
